review.imagery: All 39 indexed source pages, two own-page image contacts, 16 extracted native resources, five whole residence pages, the complete regional map and master plan, both factsheets and all ten enlarged numerical schedules visually reviewed. The paired drawings preserve ten townhouse types and all ground, first and second levels. Printed sellable totals and the four component discrepancies remain explicit. Twelve project concepts include a source-published pool amenity concept. Generic lifestyle, driver, people, splash and desert stock, a distorted circular interior and repeated cropped living-room image are excluded.
review.floorPlans: Root visually reviewed every complete original source sheet and enlarged printed numerical panel. Paired types and every townhouse or duplex level remain whole. Printed figures determine selector labels, with conflicts retained explicitly.
review.location: Root read the named own-page marker, whole regional diagram and every factsheet travel estimate. Published coordinates are scoped to project vicinity. No individual entrance coordinates inferred.
review.provenance: Fresh 8 November ordinary GET receipts retain source URLs, dates, bytes and SHA256. Independent source resources, whole-sheet bounds, numerical checks and delivered pixels must pass before browser verification. Protected text research and identities remain preserved.

unavailable: Individual-home entrance coordinates, current project-specific construction photographs and selected-contract revision remain unverified. Printed component discrepancies require developer clarification.
